correction.statement: The first REPORT.md claim QFORM-FRESH-HUB-CONDITIONAL-PAIRLOG-SQUARE-v1 is a scaled re-derivation/corollary of the pre-existing account01/B11 QFORM-OVERLAP-SAFE-SQUARE-LOG-v1 and is not counted as a new analytic theorem.

substantive_result.source_family: account03/B16 r39 mixed-Pluecker absolute-TT* barrier family
substantive_result.equation: Q_bar,theta=theta H^2+2sqrt(2)HL+2P^2+4LS with L=(X1-X3)/sqrt(2), S=(X2+X4)/sqrt(2), P=(X1+X3)/sqrt(2)
substantive_result.realignment: Condition H=h, set X=X1,Y=X3,W=h+X2+X4. Then F=(X+Y)^2+2W(X-Y). On pair (X,W), B=[[1,1],[1,0]], C=[1,-1]^T, det B=-1, kappa=(sqrt(5)-1)/2, B^{-1}C=[-1,2]^T and Schur remainder 4Y^2.
substantive_result.bound: ||p_(Q_bar,theta)||_inf <=8(sqrt(5)-1)^(-1/4)=7.58716271595... for every real theta and arbitrary independent cap-one original laws.
substantive_result.interpretation: The r39 infinite absolute TT* kernel is a mechanism barrier only; that exact strict-target family is uniformly paid by a source-preserving physical-pair completion.

canonical_compiler.equation: F=lambda(X+Y)^2+2nu W(X-Y), with X,Y independent cap-one and W independent with density cap K
canonical_compiler.novelty_scope: structural compiler/application only; analytic inequality inherited from B11

unresolved_implication.statement: In a generic majority-sign near-coloop survivor, either find a source-preserving orientation that realigns the mixed phase to a quantitatively good indefinite pair plus scalar quadratic Schur remainder, or build a cancellation-preserving TT*/Hilbert receiver for the residual mixed-volume packet. A bounded projected joint density and total mixed Pluecker mass alone are insufficient.
